summary: RptMnuPlcSch_ConfirmLetters implements a web control for generating and managing confirmation letter reports for placement schedules. It provides dropdowns for department, program, and term selection, allows users to choose included cohorts/courses, and offers various report options such as including specific user roles or generating individual PDF files. The component dynamically binds dropdowns and validates report creation criteria, while providing descriptive information and notes for the report.
purpose: To facilitate the generation of placement schedule confirmation letter reports with configurable options, ensuring data is appropriately filtered and validated, and automating the report creation workflow for authorized users within an agency.

workflows.name: Confirmation Letter Report Generation
steps: User loads page – department, program, and term dropdowns are populated based on UserSession and agency permissions.
User selects department, triggering program and term dropdowns to refresh.
User selects program, triggering term dropdown to refresh.
Available cohorts/courses are populated in UCchoosers.NotIncludedList based on program and term selection.
User selects sender (staff) and selects desired options (include HSPnet users, supervisors, course leaders, instructors, student name, individual PDFs).
System validates report creation criteria (CustomValidator2 checks maximum included items).
If valid, PrintJobs.ReportConfLetterCreateJob is called with selected parameters to generate the report.

business_rules: Departments and programs are filtered according to UserSession permissions; UserSession.AllowAllDepartments and UserSession.AllowAllPrograms determine scope.
Max included courses/cohorts are constrained by PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
Options to CC supervisors, course leaders, and instructors are provided based on user role captions and agency resource definitions.
CustomValidator2 ensures that the report is not created if the maximum allowed courses/cohorts is exceeded.
validations: CustomValidator2: The report is not generated if the maximum number of included courses/cohorts is exceeded.
ObjectDataSource dsSender: Cancels data fetch if UserSession is null; otherwise, it passes SessionID and AgencyID.
Dropdown selections trigger dependent dropdowns to be refreshed (department → program → term).
calculations: Course/cohort filtering for UCchoosers.NotIncludedList takes UserSession.CourseLeaderOnly into account.
Dynamic JavaScript variables for maximum allowed items and search variables.
conditions: Dropdown bindings are conditional on UserSession and item counts.
Sender data is only fetched if UserSession is valid.
Report creation only proceeds if all validations pass.
system_behavior: On page load, dropdowns and control texts are initialized based on resources and user session.
On PreRender, controls are further initialized and JavaScript setup is triggered.
Dropdown changes cascade to refresh dependent data sources.
Report creation is automated via PrintJobs.ReportConfLetterCreateJob with user-selected options.
Dynamic notes and descriptions are provided from Codes.CodeLookupCodes.
exceptions: Report not created if maximum included courses/cohorts are exceeded.
Sender selection is canceled if UserSession is null.
content_gaps: No explicit user interface layouts or full resource values are provided.
Detailed formatting or template of the confirmation letters is not shown.
No security or audit rule documentation is included.
No explicit error handling beyond maximum included items and session validation.
